stable.title: DroidDeck 0.7.1
stable.summary: DroidDeck is 100% open source. No ads. No telemetry. No proprietary components. No source withheld.

preview.title: feat(agent): choose the reasoning effort in the Agent tab
preview.summary: The model picker in the Agent tab gets a Reasoning effort row: Default plus the levels each CLI accepts. Claude Code gets low to max through --effort; Codex gets low to high through -c modelreasoningeffort. The choice is saved per CLI and shown in the header.

recentPreviews.title: feat(agent): choose the reasoning effort in the Agent tab
recentPreviews.summary: The model picker in the Agent tab gets a Reasoning effort row: Default plus the levels each CLI accepts. Claude Code gets low to max through --effort; Codex gets low to high through -c modelreasoningeffort. The choice is saved per CLI and shown in the header.

recentPreviews.title: fix(stores): EA and Ubisoft libraries list only games the account can download
recentPreviews.summary: The EA and Ubisoft libraries listed games the account can't download or play. This keeps only real entitlements.

recentPreviews.title: fix(memory): reclaim idle session memory under pressure
recentPreviews.summary: Issue #945 exposed a RAM-size gate that disabled idle session reclaim above 13 GiB. MemAvailable alone also overstated headroom during rapid GPU and system-reserved memory growth.

recentPreviews.title: feat(ui): option to hide the Agent tab
recentPreviews.summary: Adds an Agent tab toggle to Setup → Launcher (shown only when the agent is available, on by default).

recentPreviews.title: fix(session): preserve guest monotonic time after long pauses
recentPreviews.summary: The pause clock compensation was limited to plasmashell, although session guests load the same preload. A long background pause therefore exposed the full CLOCKMONOTONIC gap to guest processes. The report log shows SIGCONT at 15:31:57.381, 2065 MB left in zRAM at 15:31:57.447, and the game window closing at 15:32:01.216. The zRAM pass also ran at 15:32:00.528, so memory pressure remains an op

recentPreviews.title: fix(proot): a call the filesystem does not implement no longer switches the fast path off
recentPreviews.summary: Reserving space, verifying and installing on a storage card are far slower than the card itself.

recentPreviews.title: fix(lab): reuse installed add-on packs so the Agent can restart
recentPreviews.summary: A Lab build can restore the Agent chat but fail to launch Codex when the checkout pins a different proot pack from the one installed on the device. The saved failure was Cannot run program .../addons/proot/<source-pin>/libproot.so: error=2, No such file or directory.

recentPreviews.title: fix(agent): the agent survives Steam session starts, stops and restarts
recentPreviews.summary: Whenever a session started or stopped, including when the agent itself ran droiddeckctl start, stop or a Steam restart, the app killed the agent's own turn:

recentPreviews.title: feat: add build watermark toggle for Lab, test, and local builds
recentPreviews.summary:
• Add a Build label watermark toggle at the bottom of the Updates tab.
• Control both test-build and Lab-build watermarks, including the Lab label shown over an installed release build.
• Keep the watermark enabled by default. Users can hide or restore it immediately, and their choice persists across restarts.
• Include translated setting text for all 32 non-English locale variants, alongside Engl

recentPreviews.title: fix(input): a controller that disconnects mid-event no longer closes the app
recentPreviews.summary: DroidDeck can close during a session with NullPointerException in PadBridge.noteDevice when a controller disconnects while one of its key events is being handled. KeyEvent.getDevice() looks the device up again on every call, so the first lookup (to pick the player slot) finds the controller and a later one in the same event returns null.

tests.title: feat(stores): EA and Ubisoft stores browse their catalogs with prices, deals and search
tests.summary: The EA and Ubisoft store tabs used to show only the account's own games under Trending. They now browse each store's catalog like GOG and Epic: What's New, Deals, Free Games and Trending rows, search, prices with discounts, and a Buy link for games the account doesn't own. Owned games in a row or in search results turn into the account's library entry, so they install as before.

tests.title: feat(stores): show the pre-install size in store game details
tests.summary: EA game details can show no pre-install size on the status line or Install button. CatalogItem.sizeBytes remains 0 until a size lookup runs, and the detail page did not request one.

tests.title: fix(native): drive links stored as rootfs paths reach the game library mount
tests.summary: With "Run without Proot", Windows games installed on a game storage library quit a few seconds after launch. Wine logs could not open working directory L"Z:\\mnt\\droiddeck-sd\\<game>\\", starting in the Windows directory.

tests.title: fix: refresh the session loading tips
tests.summary: Rewrites the tips shown while a Steam or desktop session loads. The old ones said the controller defaults to an Xbox 360 pad and that leaving the app pauses by default, neither of which is true now. New tips cover the controller types, held Back for Quick Access, background behavior modes, frame limit, low latency, game profiles, mic and suspend, HUD docking, dual-screen bottom screen and swap, ex

tests.title: fix(gamescope): release Vulkan resources before exit
tests.summary: Gamescope faults with SIGSEGV after its primary child exits in the Desktop window path. Logs show the same shutdown sequence for unrelated Windows programs on Adreno 735 and Adreno 840 devices. The Desktop-mode report is from Xiaomi / Adreno 735 (DroidDeck 0.7.1). Gamescope issue #2516 is a separate Linux/NVIDIA report of a crash at exit; i

tests.title: feat: Add Soundtracks tab and music player
tests.summary: Adds a Music tab under Library with a built-in player, an Android media session, playback options, Favorites and collections.

tests.title: feat(library): pick the game resolution for games started without Steam
tests.summary: Games set to Start without Steam always ran at the full panel resolution. Steam lets you pick a game's resolution; this brings the same to no-Steam launches.

tests.title: fix(epic): hand Epic's terms step to the browser instead of looping the sign-in
tests.summary: Epic sign-in keeps restarting for accounts with a pending terms step (a new account created at sign-in, or updated terms). Epic's redirect page then returns errors.com.epicgames.oauth.correctiveactionrequired with correctiveAction PRIVACYPOLICYACCEPTANCE or EULAACCEPTANCE instead of an authorization code (reporter screenshots in the Discord bug thread). EpicLogin.finish finds no cod

tests.title: Feat:Add per-game frame generation profiles
tests.summary: Add per game frame generation profiles, so you can choose what game and what configuration.

tests.title: fix(ui): show dialogs on the second-screen menu without a separate platform window
tests.summary: Opening Game environment from the menu docked on the second screen crashed the app on Android 13 (AYN Thor, 0.7.1): IllegalArgumentException: Window type mismatch. Window Context's window type is 2037, while LayoutParams' type is set to 2 in Dialog.show (crash.log lines 5-38 and 39-72 of the reporter's bundle). The second-screen menu is composed inside a Presentation (SecondScreenPresentati

tests.title: fix(components): keep Mono away from framework GAC
tests.summary: The .NET 4.8 component leaves Wine's builtin mscoree active, so Wine Mono starts while the installed framework GAC remains searchable. Dust then loads Mono mscorlib and native C:\windows\Microsoft.NET\assembly\GACMSIL\System.dll together, and Transistor fails during .NET initialization. Evidence: tools/linuxfs/overlay/usr/local/bin/droiddeck-wincomponents:64-67, /home/max/.local/share/dr

tests.title: ci: run Python and native regression tests on the workstation runner when idle
tests.summary: Experiment: routes the Python and native regression tests job through the same idle-runner picker as components and compile, to measure the time saved against the extra load on the workstation runners.

tests.title: fix(desktop): serve PipeWire in Desktop mode so screen capture works
tests.summary: Desktop mode launches Plasma without the bundled PipeWire service. Sunshine's portal remote desktop request fails (RemoteDesktop Start failed with response code: 2), leaving streaming clients without a capturable display.

tests.title: fix(retroarch): use the packaged assets, cores and core info paths
tests.summary: RetroArch showed black icons, "No Core," and "Fetching core list..." droiddeck-pad-defaults creates retroarch.cfg before the first run, so the packaged RetroArch system config is not loaded. RetroArch can then use empty per-user asset and core paths instead of the paths containing the packaged files. On a Retroid Pocket Duo, pointing the config at the packaged paths restored the icons.

tests.title: fix(steam): share the Steam app's prefix with shortcuts of the same install
tests.summary: A game installed through the Steam client had its cloud saves downloaded into compatdata/<appid>, but launching the same install folder as an added game ran it as a shortcut with its own compatdata/<shortcut id> prefix, so the saves were not there. The report's session log shows the ownership probe failed because the Steam pipe was unavailable, so the importer kept the folder as a shortcut.

tests.title: feat(boot-movie): add a Shuffle switch backed by Steam's startup movie shuffle setting
tests.summary: Settings > Boot movie > Installed only lets one movie be picked. Steam can shuffle its startup movies (client setting startupmovieshuffle, read by its UI in steamui/sp.js), but DroidDeck offered no way to turn that on, so the same movie played every start.

tests.title: feat: Trinkets tab with a Bluetooth controller mode
tests.summary: Adds a Trinkets tab to the rail. Its first entry turns the device into a Bluetooth gamepad for another PC, phone or handheld.

tests.title: fix(session): keep the zram swap reserve when paging a session out on suspend
tests.summary: A tester on a 16 GB handheld (14.9 GB reported) reports every game resuming briefly after sleep before Android closes the app for memory. The attached session shows the suspend page-out filling the device swap: before the page-out, swap was 2035/4095 MB; after, 3983/4095 MB, with 63 session processes paged out. Because the 4 GB zram was then almost full, Android had no swap left for its own proces

tests.title: fix(drivers): Auto gives Xclipse GPUs the old RADV pair only where that build supports them
tests.summary: On a Galaxy A56 (Xclipse 540), Auto picked the older "RADV · Samsung Xclipse" pair. Steam was black and ran at about 1 fps. RADV identified the GPU as "AMD Radeon Graphics (RADV VANGOGH)", then logged radv/amdgpu: The CS has been rejected (-22) and VKERRORDEVICELOST.

tests.title: fix(hud): keep floating HUD widths stable as readings change
tests.summary: Numeric readings changing digit count could change the width of floating performance HUDs and resize their outline, especially in Mega mode.

tests.title: fix(zram): page game memory out on a worker thread, not the signalled game thread
tests.summary: On 11-12 GB devices games still froze for 5-10 s with every core busy, about every 30 s while free memory stayed under ~1 GB. The low-memory page-out (#2187, with #2312's read-back backoff) was working as designed, but tools/linuxfs/preload/zram.c ran the whole page-out inside its SIGURG handler. That handler runs on whichever thread receives the signal, often a game thread (render or main), a

tests.title: fix(framegen): translate game and default setting scopes
tests.summary: The two frame-generation scope labels in #2297 exist only in English, so other languages fall back to English.

tests.title: feat(quest): show the child-process command with SideQuest steps on Quest
tests.summary: Quest headsets have no Developer options switch for child-process restrictions and no Wireless debugging, so the "Fix it" page pointed Quest users at options that do not exist there. The only way to turn the limit off is ADB from a computer, usually through SideQuest.

tests.title: fix(graphics): make Auto-owned Mali fallback state explicit
tests.summary: Auto treated the default Mali bridge state as user-owned state. When a matched non-Adreno pair was already installed, Auto could leave the bridge enabled and the session used it instead of the selected runtime pair. The report is Discord log 1569562430973943871; no matching GitHub issue was found.

tests.title: fix(input): screen taps move the pointer without clicking while an on-screen mouse button is shown
tests.summary: When an on-screen control bound to a mouse button (left, right or middle) was on screen, tapping the game picture still clicked. Players who place their own click buttons want the screen to move the pointer and the button to do the clicking. Direct touch sent every tap to the guest as a touch, which the guest treats as a click. Touchpad mode turned taps, double taps, holds and two-finger taps into

tests.title: fix(dual-screen): allow game swap to external second screens
tests.summary: The in-game "Game screen" choice and the docked swap button were only offered when the second screen is built in (DualScreen.builtIn). A clip-on dual-screen add-on reports as an external display, so the game could not be moved to it.

tests.title: feat(stores): editable launch options for EA store games
tests.summary: Games installed from the EA Store had no way to take launch arguments. The Launch tab only offered launch options for Steam and plain added games, the listing dropped any saved value for store games, and the generated EA launcher ignored arguments passed by the Steam shortcut. Some titles need an executable flag to start or run correctly.

tests.title: fix(gamescope): retry a failed nested swapchain rebuild and log why it failed
tests.summary: On a Pixel 10 Pro (PowerVR D-Series DXT-48-1536 MC1, system driver through libhybris, 0.7.1), a Steam session ended about 14 s after start, just as Big Picture took focus:

tests.title: fix(components): install the real ARM64 Visual C++ runtime instead of registry entries
tests.summary: Enabling the Visual C++ 2015-2022 ARM64 component only wrote VC\Runtimes\arm64 registry values (WinComponents.builtInArm64Runtime). No runtime binaries were supplied, so an ARM64 program that needs them still hit the missing-runtime dialog (#2412). The package engine also dropped every ARM64 MSI (SKIPPLATFORMS in droiddeck-msi-install), so pointing the component at the real redistributabl

tests.title: fix(fex): supply current Wayland libraries in the shared runtime
tests.summary: Imported x8664 AppImages can bundle GTK built against a newer Wayland ABI than Sniper provides. The support report at https://discord.com/channels/1552707793247539220/1556195514322780160/1569785897027764254 has a desktop launch log whose entry log line 280 reports undefined symbol: wlproxymarshalflags. Forcing X11 does not supply that missing symbol.

tests.title: fix(audio): restart host after stalled wake recovery
tests.summary: After a long device sleep, the resumed AAudio stream could fail to start. Reopening the stream repeatedly succeeded at the API level, but the callback never ran, leaving the audio host in an endless two-second reopen loop.

tests.title: feat(performance): switch to turn off idle game memory compression
tests.summary: The Performance switch for Steam compression did not control the separate low-memory session reclaim path. On supported low-RAM devices, blsessionpressure could still compress idle game processes when available memory was low.

tests.title: fix(graphics): fall back from unsupported auto display drivers
tests.summary: Auto used the bundled turnip25.1.0 display driver for Adreno 710/720/722 because TurnipDriver.chooseByModel grouped every model from 700 to 799 together. On those chips that driver enumerates no Vulkan physical device. The compositor logged present: no physical devices / DDPRESENTFAULT, so the session drew frames that never reached the screen (Steam stuck on its first frame).

tests.title: feat: emulate LSE atomics so the Steam client starts on ARMv8.0 CPUs
tests.summary: Valve's arm64 Steam client builds after April 15 2026 use ARMv8.1 LSE atomics (ldaddal, casal, swp), so the client dies with SIGILL and a black screen on ARMv8.0 CPUs: Cortex-A53/A57/A72/A73, e.g. the Snapdragon 685 in #380. Valve has not answered ValveSoftware/steam-for-linux#13288. Pinning an old client doesn't stick because it self-updates.

tests.title: Add per-game Steam Input overrides
tests.summary: Add per-game Steam Input controls for Steam's default, enabled, and disabled modes to address #693.

tests.title: fix(epic): install the Epic Games Launcher from its Linux .deb
tests.summary: Epic stopped publishing the Linux AppImage: EpicGamesLauncher-x8664.AppImage now answers 404 appdirecturlnotfound (30003), so Install in Epic's profile strip fails for everyone. Epic ships the launcher as EpicGamesLauncher-x8664.deb (0.113.0) instead.

tests.title: fix(dual-screen): the bottom-screen terminal keeps its shell when another app covers that screen
tests.summary: Opening any app on the bottom screen dismisses SecondScreenPresentation, and its dismiss listener closed the terminal panel, killing its shell and everything started from it. A sign-in opened in Android's browser on that screen (Claude Code's OAuth, gh auth login) killed the program waiting for the browser's localhost redirect, so the browser got "connection refused".

tests.title: fix(zram): back off ineffective idle compression
tests.summary: On low-RAM devices the session compresses idle game memory whenever MemAvailable is under the tier headroom, at most every 30 seconds. A shared log from a 6.9 GB phone showed four passes in about a minute: each took about 5 s and caused a stutter, resident memory fell from 1.8 GB to 0.5 GB, but available memory stayed around 1.2 GB. The passes kept repeating without freeing useful headroom, beca

tests.title: fix(input): detect which axis pair is the right stick
tests.summary: Some controllers report their right stick on RX/RY instead of Z/RZ. PadBridge and PadMouse always read Z/RZ unless the pad matches one of the two wired layouts, so on those controllers the right stick never reaches the game or the pointer.

tests.title: perf(turnip): system-memory rendering for games and apps by default
tests.summary: The "Turnip: sysmem rendering" setting (on by default) only reached the Steam client. Games got DROIDDECKGAMETUDEBUG empty unless the runtime driver was the 710-720 build, so droiddeck-game-env removed TUDEBUG and Turnip chose tile (GMEM) or system-memory rendering per pass. #1188 set up that split.

tests.title: fix(input): the controls editor shows the layout the game uses
tests.summary: In 0.7.0 the on-screen controls editor drew the layout squashed and overlapping: triggers in one row, face buttons and d-pad stretched into overlapping pills, small sticks. The same layout was fine in the game, so it could not really be edited. Reported on a 20:9 phone (2608x1200). The editor drew the stored element coordinates directly, while the game places them through OnScreenLayout.elements(

tests.title: feat(steam): adopt game folders found in added libraries
tests.summary: A shared library copied from another client (for example game folders on an SD card) only shows its games in Steam once each game has an appmanifest<id>.acf. Users had to press Install on every game and pick that library before Steam adopted the files.

tests.title: fix(venus): DXVK runs on Mali GPUs without dual-source blending
tests.summary: On Mali GPUs whose Vulkan driver lacks dualSrcBlend (seen on a Mali-G68 through Venus), DXVK finds no usable GPU and D3D11 apps crash at start:

tests.title: feat: add community on-screen controls
tests.summary: Adds Community controls to controller settings with source selection, searchable packs and previews, local ZIP import/export, and per-game screen profiles.

tests.title: feat: a per-game relative mouse switch for games that confine and warp the cursor
tests.summary: Some games read the mouse by confining it and warping it back, so in a Steam session the pointer stops at the screen edge and aim is capped by screen size.

tests.title: feat: Performance boost switch for any phone, with Samsung clock floors and a boost report
tests.summary: A Boost group in Settings → Performance: a switch that asks the phone for more speed while a game falls behind, a log of what it did, and a test mode that measures whether it helps. This PR is mainly for testers: no frame-rate gain has been measured yet.

tests.title: Proton: QueryPerformanceCounter reads the CPU timer on ARM64EC
tests.summary: Windows on ARM answers QueryPerformanceCounter from the CPU's generic timer without leaving user space. Wine's ARM64EC ntdll makes a system call for every one: through FEX's syscall callback and Wine's dispatcher into clockgettime. DroidDeck-Proton's own user-mode TSC patch excludes ARM64EC, so phones still pay for every read.

tests.title: test: frame-order glitch on Adreno 740: order and producer-fence logging, draw on the tick
tests.summary: Diagnostic build, not for merge.

tests.title: feat(input): add native PS5 DualSense & DualSense Edge wireless/wired support
fix: a recreated launcher screen keeps running installs and save work busy
tests.summary: After the launcher screen is recreated (a language change, a settings reset, or a configuration change it doesn't handle), work that is still running stays marked busy. It is no longer possible to start a session or remove the Linux runtime while that work is writing into it.

tests.title: fix: a failing agent environment no longer blocks session start
tests.summary: Sessions now start even if the agent environment state can't be read or written.

tests.title: fix: Steam's first frame no longer waits on the client re-downloading itself; a crawling source is dropped for a faster one
tests.summary: Main already falls back from a client-update host that does not answer. It still starts with whichever one answers the manifest first, and that is rarely the fastest. The install now measures all three by fetching the head of the largest component from each, keeps the fastest, and prints the host and the rate it measured, so the log says which one it used. The x86-64 client's own install does th

tests.title: feat: add maintenance for other game stores
tests.summary: Installed games outside GOG lacked a consistent maintenance workflow. This adds metadata-only update checks and a compact Maintenance menu, pins queued targets to their existing installation folder, and preserves installation settings through maintenance and recovery.

tests.title: fix: keep 6+2 Oryon cores, Fold SoC names, and 120 Hz display mode across fold changes
tests.summary: Keep all 8 cores in programcores() on 6+2 Oryon SoCs (SM8750-AC / SM8850-AC), strip Samsung -AC/-AB SoC model suffixes in SocNames (alongside the canoe / Adreno 840 platform entries and a hex gpuchipid guard), and pin preferredDisplayModeId across fold/unfold configuration changes in PerfMode and SessionActivity.

tests.title: fix: duplicate cursors and clicks that miss in a game session
tests.summary: Problem. Input in a game session went wrong in several ways:

tests.title: fix: the virtual pads reach non-Steam programs, where udev is resolved through dlsym
tests.summary: Outside Steam the pads were invisible: Firefox and Chromium load libudev with dlopen and look the symbols up with dlsym, which skips interposition, so the browser found no pad even though the virtual device was there. SDL2 (SDLudev.c) and hidapi's Linux backend take the same route, so any program outside Steam that enumerates udev input devices missed them too.

tests.title: feat(input): make the controls toggle and keyboard buttons movable in the layout editor
tests.summary: The controls toggle and the keyboard button were drawn at fixed offsets from the screen corner, so the layout editor could not show or move them: they were not part of the control list, and their positions came from hardcoded insets.

tests.title: Let a game override the session locale
tests.summary:
Wine takes a game's language and codepage from LANG, and every game runs in
C.UTF-8: the rootfs ships only C.utf8, and the session sets LANG=C.UTF-8 for
the whole guest. A game that reads the locale itself starts with the wrong
language and codepage under that, and will not get past its own startup.

tests.title: itch.io: install Linux builds and start them through Steam
tests.summary: Follow-up to #1503. Linux builds in the itch.io version picker, which were listed as "Not supported yet", can now be installed and started through Steam like every other game.

tests.title: Experimental Qualcomm proprietary driver backend for the Linux runtime
tests.summary: This adds an experimental Qualcomm proprietary driver backend for DroidDeck's Linux runtime. Steam, Proton and Linux apps can run on the phone's own Adreno Vulkan driver (or an imported AdrenoTools driver) instead of Turnip. Proton games, the Steam client and Zink-based OpenGL all present through it. The phone's system graphics stack is not modified and nothing needs root.

tests.title: Add opt-in Pixel WoW64 and D3D9 compatibility tools
tests.summary: American Nightmare (Steam 202750) on the tested Pixel PowerVR/WoW64 setup first stopped because device-backed GPU allocations mapped above 4 GiB could not be represented by Wine's 32-bit bridge. After that was addressed, the 3D scene showed bright dotted triangle edges over textured geometry. This submits the reviewed, opt-in low32 and D3D9 single-sample workarounds directly to official DroidDeck,

tests.title: Retain compositor resources when GPU completion is unconfirmed
tests.summary: Finite fence waits can fail while submitted GPU work is still pending. Continuing or tearing down after that result can reset resources still in use or free image memory before completion. This adds a terminal completion-unknown state that stops further presentation and retains pending resources until the app process exits, while preserving the existing genuine-device-loss path.

tests.title: Accessibility tab: install and enable Orca in every Linux session
tests.summary: Adds an Accessibility tab to the launcher's front-end rail: an introduction to Orca (the GNOME screen reader), an install button, an open-settings button and a master switch that defaults on after install.

tests.title: Controller: stick dead zone setting and per-controller profiles (test build, not for merge yet)
tests.summary: This is for testing only, please don't merge it yet. I want a release-signed test build to try on a Galaxy S25 Ultra with an MCON controller, and I haven't run any of it on a device. I'll say when it has been tried and it's ready for review, or I'll close it. Plan and discussion: #580.

tests.title: feat: detailed adds startup step times and game logs, and the diagnostics page has a log level
tests.summary:
The diagnostics page now has a log level under "Session logs", shown only while session
logs are on. Standard is what ships today. Detailed adds:

tests.title: feat: target Android API 36
tests.summary: Moves the app from targetSdk 28 to targetSdk 36 (compileSdk 34 → 36).

tests.title: fix(session): prevent overlapping startup and teardown
tests.summary: Users reported Steam appearing offline. Logs showed Session Replaced after successful sign-in, while downloads still worked. This PR prevents overlapping local sessions, one possible cause, but does not establish the cause of those reports.

tests.title: Rumble: reliable controller motors, Deck haptics, optional Razer Kishi USB rumble; Kishi L4/R4 as Deck back grips
tests.summary: ﻿Fixes the rumble part of #219 / follow-up to #242. Reported in the DroidDeck Discord #bug-reports forum (Kishi V3 Pro on a Galaxy S26 Ultra), with logs there.
